query:
SELECT round, COUNT(*) as cnt, MIN(kickoffUtcMs) as earliest, MAX(kickoffUtcMs) as latest FROM matches WHERE category = 'world_cup' GROUP BY round ORDER BY CAST(round AS UNSIGNED) ASC;
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM matches WHERE category = 'world_cup';
